description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast], [Twin Element Mode III (Fire, Earth)] and [Vagrant Knight Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Fire, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Earth ability

description.name: Vagrant Knight Mode
description.text: After using two of Crimson Charge or Crimson Break, casts Crimson Gamma 1/2 if the character has Vagrant Knight Alpha 0~1/2~3 and Vagrant Knight Beta 0~1/2~3, Crimson Alpha 1/2 if the character has Vagrant Knight Alpha 2/3 and Vagrant Knight Beta 0~1, Crimson Beta 1/2 if the character has Vagrant Knight Alpha 0~1 and Vagrant Knight Beta 2/3
